policies.name: story_sounds_select
policies.using: ((owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR sound_rights_allow(id, 'story'::text) OR sound_rights_allow(id, 'post'::text) OR sound_rights_allow(id, 'memory_album'::text))

constraints.name: sound_permitted_uses
constraints.definition: CHECK (((permitted_uses <@ ARRAY['story'::text, 'post'::text, 'memory_album'::text, 'advertisement'::text]) AND (cardinality(permitted_uses) > 0) AND (array_position(permitted_uses, NULL::text) IS NULL)))

constraints.name: sound_rights_window
constraints.definition: CHECK (((rights_end IS NULL) OR (rights_start IS NULL) OR (rights_end > rights_start)))

constraints.name: sound_territories
constraints.definition: CHECK (((cardinality(territories) > 0) AND (array_position(territories, NULL::text) IS NULL) AND (array_to_string(territories, ','::text) ~ '^(\*|[A-Z]{2})(,(\*|[A-Z]{2}))*$'::text)))

constraints.name: story_sounds_origin_story_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (origin_story_id) REFERENCES stories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: story_sounds_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sound_asset_origin_allowed(p_url text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(p_url ~ '^https://[^/]+/storage/v1/object/public/story-media/[^?#]+$'
 and split_part(p_url,'/story-media/',2) !~ '(%|\\|(^|/)\.\.?(/|$)|//)'
 and (
  (split_part(p_url,'/storage/v1/object/public/',1)=regexp_replace(auth.jwt()->>'iss','/auth/v1/?$','')
   and coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'iss','') ~ '^https://[^/]+/auth/v1/?$')
  or exists(select 1 from public.music_asset_origins where origin=split_part(p_url,'/storage/v1/object/public/',1))
 ),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.keep_sound_asset_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.url is distinct from old.url then raise exception 'SOUND_ASSET_IMMUTABLE_PUBLISH_NEW_VERSION'; end if;
 return new;
end $function$

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX music_asset_origins_pkey ON public.music_asset_origins USING btree (origin)
CREATE INDEX story_sound_asset_lookup ON public.story_sounds USING btree (url)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX story_sound_catalog_identity ON public.story_sounds USING btree (catalog_provider, provider_track_id) WHERE (provider_track_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX story_sounds_available_popularity ON public.story_sounds USING btree (source, use_count DESC, id) WHERE (rights_status = ANY (ARRAY['creator_attested'::text, 'licensed'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX story_sounds_origin_story_unique ON public.story_sounds USING btree (origin_story_id) WHERE (origin_story_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX story_sounds_pkey ON public.story_sounds USING btree (id)
